description: This file defines the 'Profile' structure and related functions for managing telemetry reporting profiles, including profile creation, deletion, enabling/disabling, and trigger conditions.

classes.name: JSONEncoding
classes.description: Structure representing JSON report format and timestamp format.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Structure representing a telemetry profile with various configuration flags, parameters, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: initProfileList
methods.description: Initializes the profile list.

methods.name: uninitProfileList
methods.description: Uninitializes the profile list.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a new profile to the list.

methods.name: getProfileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of profiles.

methods.name: profileWithNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a profile with the given name exists.

methods.name: Profile_storeMarkerEvent
methods.description: Stores a marker event for a profile.

methods.name: enableProfile
methods.description: Enables a profile by name.

methods.name: disableProfile
methods.description: Disables a profile by name.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a profile by name.

methods.name: deleteAllProfiles
methods.description: Deletes all profiles, optionally from disk.

methods.name: updateMarkerComponentMap
methods.description: Updates the marker component map.

methods.name: getProfileHashMap
methods.description: Returns the hash map of profiles.

methods.name: sendLogUploadInterruptToScheduler
methods.description: Sends an interrupt to the scheduler to upload logs.

methods.name: NotifyTimeout
methods.description: Notifies a profile timeout event.

methods.name: getMarkerCompRbusSub
methods.description: Gets marker component RBus subscription status.

methods.name: isProfileEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a profile is enabled.

methods.name: registerTriggerConditionConsumer
methods.description: Registers a trigger condition consumer.

methods.name: triggerReportOnCondtion
methods.description: Triggers report generation based on a condition.

methods.name: getMinThresholdDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum threshold duration for a profile.

methods.name: reportGenerationCompleteReceiver
methods.description: Handles report generation completion.

methods.name: NotifySchedulerstart
methods.description: Notifies that the scheduler has started for a profile.
